title: Chlöe Bailey Dresses Up as ‘Hot Meg Griffin’ From ‘Family Guy’ for Halloween & SZA Loves It
contentText:
Spooky season is upon us, and Chlöe Bailey got a head-start on the festivities, dressing up as Meg Griffin from Family Guy for Halloween.

“Hot Meg Griffin,” Chlöe captioned Monday’s (Oct. 26) sexy photo shoot on Instagram. The “Treat Me” singer went with silver knee-high heel boots, a jean miniskirt, a pink bra top and a matching wool cap, along with a pair of round-frame glasses.

Nobody was telling Meg to shut up in the comments section, as Chlöe’s music peers gave her a ton of love for the costume. “Sooo cutie patoootie,” SZA gushed.

Lauren Jauregui lent her stamp of approval: “Love thisss.”

There’s a bit of lore here, as an August tweet went viral with an X user comparing Chlöe to the Family Guy character. “Yall treat chloe bailey like meg griffin omg,” they wrote. The tweet has more than 59,000 likes.

However, Chlöe got the last laugh, when the 28-year-old clapped back on Monday with a picture of her Meg costume. “Aw shucks,” she quipped. Fans hyped her up in the replies. “WWW THIS ATE, you so cute,” one person responded.

aw shucks https://t.co/Dd2GIFXT6T pic.twitter.com/DA3IrrYGpY

— Chlöe (@ChloeBailey) October 26, 2026

The comparisons seemed to come from Meg’s character being made into the scapegoat of the Griffin family, which fans matched up with Chlöe facing what they felt was unfair backlash and criticism on social media.

On the music front, Chlöe released a remix of her Timbaland-produced “Main Attraction” featuring an assist from Monaleo, which arrived on Oct. 16.
